name: Roblox

changelog: Regular bug fixes and improvements for speed and reliability.

summary: The Roblox APK is the official Android app for Roblox, where you play millions of games, called experiences, made by other players and chat with friends. Google Play updated it on November 18, 2026, and it needs Android 8.0 or newer. It's free to play, with Robux sold in the app.
metaDescription: Roblox APK download for Android: get the official Roblox app from Google Play, with install steps, parental controls for kids and fixes when it's laggy.

faq.a: Roblox can be safe for young children with parental controls switched on. Link a parent account, set content maturity to the lowest level, limit or turn off chat, and set a monthly spending limit. Play together at first so you know which experiences they use.

faq.q: Why is Roblox not working today?
faq.a: Check your connection, update Roblox from Google Play and restart the phone. If many people are affected, Roblox may be down; its status page shows outages.
Yes. Roblox is free to download and play. Robux, the in-game currency, is sold in the app and used for avatar items and upgrades in experiences.

faq.q: Roblox vs Minecraft: which is safer?
faq.a: Minecraft can be played completely offline, which makes it easier to control. Roblox is built around online play and chat with others, so it needs parental controls to be safe for young children.
